gui.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.facing: Facing: %s (the area turns with the block)
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.empty: No area yet: set every size above 0
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.save.too: Copy everything inside this selection into every other selection block in this dimension with the same size, turned to each block's facing and recolored to each block's team.
message.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.no_s: This selection block has no area yet.
message.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.no_t: Saved, but no other selection block in this dimension has the same size (%s x %s x %s).
message.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.past: Pasted the %sx%sx%s selection into %s selection block(s) of the same size.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.team.too: When something is pasted into this area, every glazed terracotta and team bed turns this team's color. None keeps the original colors.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.randomizer.title: Randomizer Settings
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.randomizer.categor: How often this category is picked before an item inside it (compared to the other categories that have items on).
Higher = more common inside its category.
Show every item, only items that are on, or one category. With a category you can also edit its weight.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.randomizer.reset_a: Reset every item and category weight of this block to default.
message.bedwarsrandomizer.selection.skip: Skipped %s selection block(s) with a different size.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.title: Bed Wars Settings
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.countdown.too: Seconds from /bwr start until everyone is teleported to their base.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.respawn.toolt: Seconds a dead player waits (as a spectator at 0 87 0) before respawning, while their bed stands.
Blocks between the team bed and the spawn point inside the base.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.team_size.too: Players per team for players on Auto (1 = solo, 2 = doubles, ...).
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.refill.toolti: Seconds between refills: broken randomizer blocks of this kind come back in every selection block area.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.name: Player name
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.add_online.to: Adds every online player who isn't registered yet.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.team.tooltip: Auto: random team on a random island. Pick a color to put a player in that team. Left click: previous, right click: next.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.randomizer.to: Opens the randomizer drop settings (changes here that aren't saved are lost).
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.running: A game is running: team changes apply to the next game.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.role.tooltip: Hosts don't play: they watch the round as spectators and get the [Next round] / [End round] buttons. Left click: previous, right click: next.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.game.refill_now.to: Puts back every broken block of this kind right away (from the map when no round is running).
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.map.title: Choose a Map
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.map.tooltip: Pastes this map into the arena if it isn't there yet. Maps: data/bedwarsrandomizer/arena/maps in the mod, or config/bedwarsrandomizer/maps.
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.map.hint.nothing: Changes the arena map (nobody is teleported)
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.map.hint.teleport_: Then everyone registered is teleported to the lobby
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.map.hint.go_to_lob: No map chosen yet: pick one, then you go to the lobby
gui.bedwarsrandomizer.map.hint.start: No map chosen yet: pick one, then the round starts
